entries.title: Primal

emulation.emulator: Sony PS2-on-PS4 emulator; PCSX2 for owned-disc preservation
emulation.notes: Use the PlayStation Store release for the official primary route. PCSX2 is useful for preservation capture from an owned PS2 copy but is not the official storefront route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official up-rendered PS2 presentation with Trophy support on PlayStation hardware, or higher emulator-side resolution through PCSX2.

primary.why: The PlayStation Store release is an official PS2-on-PS4 version with up-rendering and Trophy support, making it the highest-fidelity official route while keeping the original game content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Primal on the PlayStation Store or access it through PlayStation Plus Premium where available; play on PS4 or on PS5 via backward compatibility.

all_releases.reason: skip: complete original release, but superseded for fidelity by the official PS2-on-PS4 version.

all_releases.fidelity: PS2 Classic downloadable release for PS3.
all_releases.reason: skip: official access route, but it lacks the PS4 version's up-rendering and Trophy support.

all_releases.fidelity: Official PS2-on-PS4 release with up-rendering and Trophies; playable on PS5 via backward compatibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: best official fidelity route and still preserves the original PS2 game content.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PS4/PS5 route improves fidelity while preserving the original PS2 game content; no exclusive-content tradeoff was identified.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is an emulated PS2-on-PS4 release with up-rendering and Trophies, not a full remake or asset-level remaster.
